units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 95b:3">Snh. 95ᵇ</cite> <he>צדיק … לבית מְלוֹנִי</he> this righteous man (Jacob) has come to my lodging place; <cite ref="Chullin 91b:7">Ḥull. 91ᵇ</cite>, v. <cite ref="L00489"><he>לִינָה</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Midrash Mishlei 9:1">Midr. Prov. ch. IX</cite> <he>שנמצא לך מ׳ טוב וכ׳</he> a beautiful lodging has been offered thee in the hour of thy death; a. fr.
